            Review extracted requirements
            
These are editable drafts. Check every requirement, split combined criteria, and mark company information as Context. Keep mandatory and preferred requirements separate. Numeric bounds apply only to the unit and subject stated in the requirement.

Review evidence and build your shortlist

            
          


          

            Keep a person in the decision.
            Review each requirement and its resume evidence. “Verified” means supported by resume text, not independently authenticated. Cohorts are review suggestions; you make the final selections.

Strict and loose review cohorts
